#!/usr/bin/env bash
# deploy.sh — Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
# Usage: ./deploy.sh [output-dir]
#   output-dir  Optional destination directory for the archive (default: current directory)

set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$PWD")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-.}"          # First argument, or current directory if omitted

EXCLUDE_PATTERNS=(
  "--exclude=./.git"
  "--exclude=./node_modules"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pre-flight checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
command -v tar &>/dev/null || err "'tar' is required but was not found in PATH."

# Resolve / create the output directory
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" || err "Cannot create output directory: $OUTPUT_DIR"
OUTPUT_DIR="$(cd "$OUTPUT_DIR" && pwd)"   # absolute path

ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Make sure we won't accidentally pack the archive itself
EXCLUDE_PATTERNS+=("--exclude=${ARCHIVE_PATH}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the archive
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "Project   : $PROJECT_NAME"
log "Timestamp : $TIMESTAMP"
log "Archive   : $ARCHIVE_PATH"
log "Excluding : .git, node_modules"
log ""
log "Creating archive…"

tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" \
  "${EXCLUDE_PATTERNS[@]}" \
  .

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | cut -f1)"
log "Done! Archive size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
log "Release archive: ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# deploy.sh — Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
# Usage: ./deploy.sh [output-dir]
#   output-dir  Optional destination directory for the archive (default: current directory)

set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$PWD")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-.}"          # First argument, or current directory if omitted

EXCLUDE_PATTERNS=(
  "--exclude=./.git"
  "--exclude=./node_modules"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pre-flight checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
command -v tar &>/dev/null || err "'tar' is required but was not found in PATH."

# Resolve / create the output directory
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" || err "Cannot create output directory: $OUTPUT_DIR"
OUTPUT_DIR="$(cd "$OUTPUT_DIR" && pwd)"   # absolute path

ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Exclude the archive itself (exact path) and any *.tar.gz sitting in the
# output directory so that re-runs don't pack previous releases when the
# output directory is the project root.
EXCLUDE_PATTERNS+=("--exclude=${ARCHIVE_PATH}")
if [ "$OUTPUT_DIR" = "$PWD" ]; then
  EXCLUDE_PATTERNS+=("--exclude=./*.tar.gz")
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the archive
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "Project   : $PROJECT_NAME"
log "Timestamp : $TIMESTAMP"
log "Archive   : $ARCHIVE_PATH"
log "Excluding : .git, node_modules"
log ""
log "Creating archive…"

# Write to a temp file first so tar never sees its own output inside the
# source tree (avoids the "file changed as we read it" warning).
TMP_ARCHIVE="$(mktemp /tmp/${PROJECT_NAME}_XXXXXX.tar.gz)"
trap 'rm -f "$TMP_ARCHIVE"' EXIT   # clean up temp file on any exit

tar -czf "$TMP_ARCHIVE" \
  "${EXCLUDE_PATTERNS[@]}" \
  .

mv "$TMP_ARCHIVE" "$ARCHIVE_PATH"
trap - EXIT   # archive moved successfully — disable cleanup trap

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

log "Done! Archive size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
log "Release archive: ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"

## What the script does


| # | Decision | Why |
|---|----------|-----|

  local checked=0
  local line_number=0

pass()    { echo "[deploy]   ✔  $*"; }
fail()    { echo "[deploy]   ✘  $*" >&2; }

log_ok()  { echo "[deploy]   ✔  $*"; }
log_err() { echo "[deploy]   ✘  $*" >&2; }
fail()    { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

  local checked=0   # count of checked keys

      local value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"

      fi

      log_err "Skipping malformed line: ${line}"

  log "Checked ${checked} variable(s) — ${missing} missing."
  [[ "${missing}" -eq 0 ]] || fail "Fix the ${missing} missing value(s) in '${ENV_FILE}' before deploying."

  log "Environment validation passed."

log "  Project  : ${PROJECT_NAME}"
log "  Timestamp: ${TIMESTAMP}"
log "  Output   : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"

  "${EXCLUDES[@]}" \

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh — Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
#
# Usage:    bash deploy.sh [output-dir]

#   bash deploy.sh /tmp/dist  # saves archive to /tmp/dist
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

set -euo pipefail

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$(pwd)")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-.}"               # first argument, or current dir if omitted
ENV_FILE=".env.test"               # env file to validate before deploying

# Patterns to exclude from the archive
EXCLUDES=(
  "--exclude=./.git"
  "--exclude=./node_modules"
  "--exclude=./${ARCHIVE_NAME}"   # avoid including a previously built archive
  "--exclude=./deploy.sh"         # optional: comment out to include this script
)

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()     { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
log_ok()  { echo "[deploy]   ✔  $*"; }
log_err() { echo "[deploy]   ✘  $*" >&2; }
fail()    { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar &>/dev/null || fail "'tar' is not installed or not on PATH."

# Create the output directory if it does not yet exist
mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}" || fail "Cannot create output directory '${OUTPUT_DIR}'."

OUTPUT_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# ── Environment variable validation ──────────────────────────────────────────
validate_env() {
  local env_file="$1"
  local missing=0   # count of keys that are absent or blank
  local checked=0   # count of keys evaluated

  log "Validating environment variables from '${env_file}'..."

  # Abort early if the file doesn't exist or isn't readable
  [[ -f "${env_file}" ]]  || fail "Env file '${env_file}' not found."
  [[ -r "${env_file}" ]]  || fail "Env file '${env_file}' is not readable (check permissions)."

  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "${line}" ]]; do
    # Skip blank lines and comment lines (optional whitespace then #)
    [[ "${line}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$  ]] && continue
    [[ "${line}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*#  ]] && continue

    # Expect KEY=VALUE; warn and skip malformed lines
    if [[ "${line}" != *"="* ]]; then
      log_err "Skipping malformed line (no '=' found): ${line}"
      continue
    fi

    # Split on the FIRST '=' only so values may contain '=' themselves
    local key="${line%%=*}"
    local value="${line#*=}"

    # Strip surrounding whitespace from the key
    key="$(echo "${key}" | xargs)"

    # A key must be a valid identifier; reject anything else
    if [[ ! "${key}" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ ]]; then
      log_err "Skipping invalid key name: '${key}'"
      continue
    fi

    (( checked++ )) || true

    if [[ -z "${value}" ]]; then
      log_err "${key} is not set (empty value)"
      (( missing++ )) || true
    else
      log_ok "${key}"
    fi

  done < "${env_file}"

  # Surface a clear summary before potentially exiting
  log "Validation complete — ${checked} key(s) checked, ${missing} missing."
  [[ "${missing}" -eq 0 ]] || fail "${missing} required variable(s) are missing. Aborting deployment."
  [[ "${checked}"  -gt 0 ]] || fail "No valid key=value pairs found in '${env_file}'. Aborting deployment."
}

validate_env "${ENV_FILE}"

# ── Build archive ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Creating release archive..."
log "  Source  : $(pwd)"
log "  Output  : ${OUTPUT_PATH}"
log "  Excludes: .git, node_modules"

tar -czf "${OUTPUT_PATH}" \
  "${EXCLUDES[@]}"        \
  .

# ── Summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "${OUTPUT_PATH}" | cut -f1)"
log "Done! Archive size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
log "Archive path: ${OUTPUT_PATH}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# deploy.sh — Build a timestamped release archive of the project.
#
# Usage: ./deploy.sh [output-dir]
#
#   output-dir  Directory where the archive is written (default: ./releases)
#
# The archive excludes:
#   • node_modules/  — dependency trees (restore with `npm install`)
#   • .git/          — version-control internals
#
# Example output: releases/release-2025-01-30_14-05-22.tar.gz

set -euo pipefail

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-"${PROJECT_DIR}/releases"}"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")"
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
fail() { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

command -v tar &>/dev/null || fail "'tar' is required but was not found in PATH."

# ── Create output directory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

if [[ ! -d "${OUTPUT_DIR}" ]]; then
  log "Creating output directory: ${OUTPUT_DIR}"
  mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}"
fi

# ── Build archive ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log "Archiving '${PROJECT_DIR}' → '${ARCHIVE_PATH}'"
log "Excluding: node_modules/, .git/"

tar \
  --create \
  --gzip \
  --file  "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" \
  --exclude="./node_modules" \
  --exclude="./.git" \
  --exclude="./releases" \
  -C "${PROJECT_DIR}" \
  .

# ── Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" | cut -f1)"
log "Done! Archive size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
log "Location: ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh — Create a versioned release archive of the project
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Usage:
#   ./deploy.sh [version]
#
# Arguments:
#   version   Optional. Label used in the archive filename.
#             Defaults to a UTC timestamp: YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS
#
# Output:
#   A compressed archive at: ./releases/<project>-<version>.tar.gz
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ── Configuration ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$(pwd)")"
VERSION="${1:-$(date -u +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")}"
RELEASE_DIR="releases"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}-${VERSION}.tar.gz"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${RELEASE_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Patterns to exclude from the archive
EXCLUDES=(
  "--exclude=./.git"
  "--exclude=./node_modules"
  "--exclude=./${RELEASE_DIR}"  # avoid packing previous releases
)

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }

  [[ -z "${line}" || "${line}" == \#* ]] && continue

  line="${line#export }"

  # ── 4. Require exactly one '=' ────────────────────────────────────────
  if [[ "${line}" != *=* ]]; then
    WARNINGS+=("    ⚠️   Malformed line (no '='): ${line}")
    continue
  fi

  key="${line%%=*}"     # everything before the first '='
  value="${line#*=}"    # everything after  the first '='

  # ── 5. Validate the key is non-empty and a legal env-var name ─────────
  if [[ -z "${key}" ]]; then
    WARNINGS+=("    ⚠️   Malformed line (empty key): ${line}")
    continue
  fi
  if [[ ! "${key}" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ ]]; then
    WARNINGS+=("    ⚠️   Invalid key name '${key}': must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*")
    continue
  fi

  # ── 6. Strip inline comments from value (` # ...`) ───────────────────
  # Only strip when ' #' appears — avoids mangling URLs that contain '#'
  if [[ "${value}" == *" #"* ]]; then
    value="${value%% #*}"
  fi

  # ── 7. Strip surrounding quotes from value ────────────────────────────
  if [[ "${value}" =~ ^\"(.*)\"$ ]] || [[ "${value}" =~ ^\'(.*)\'$ ]]; then
    value="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
  fi

  # ── 8. Strip remaining whitespace from value ─────────────────────────
  value="${value#"${value%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
  value="${value%"${value##*[![:space:]]}"}"

  # ── 9. Fail if value is empty ─────────────────────────────────────────
  if [[ -z "${value}" ]]; then
    ERRORS+=("    ❌  ${key}  (empty value)")
  else
    VALID+=("    ✅  ${key}")
  fi

echo ""

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh – Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
#
# Usage:    ./deploy.sh [output-dir]
#
#   output-dir  Optional. Directory where the archive is written.
#               Defaults to the current directory.
#
# Output:   <output-dir>/release-YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.tar.gz
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

set -euo pipefail

# ── Configuration ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$PROJECT_DIR")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-$PROJECT_DIR}"
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Directories / files to exclude from the archive
EXCLUDES=(
  ".git"
  "node_modules"
)

# ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

command -v tar &>/dev/null || err "tar is required but not found in PATH."

# Ensure the output directory exists (create it if necessary)
if [[ ! -d "$OUTPUT_DIR" ]]; then

fi

# ── Build exclude flags ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

EXCLUDE_FLAGS=()
for pattern in "${EXCLUDES[@]}"; do
  EXCLUDE_FLAGS+=("--exclude=./${pattern}")
done

# Also exclude the archive itself in case it lands inside the project dir
EXCLUDE_FLAGS+=("--exclude=./${ARCHIVE_NAME}")

# ── Create the archive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log "Creating release archive..."
log "  Source  : $PROJECT_DIR"
log "  Archive : $ARCHIVE_PATH"
log "  Excluded: ${EXCLUDES[*]}"

tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" \
  "${EXCLUDE_FLAGS[@]}" \
  -C "$(dirname "$PROJECT_DIR")" \
  "$PROJECT_NAME"

# ── Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

---

## `deploy.sh` — How it works

### Usage
```bash
./deploy.sh           # archive saved in the project directory (default)
./deploy.sh /tmp/out  # archive saved in a custom output directory
```

### Output
A timestamped archive: `release-YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.tar.gz`

---

### Key design decisions

| Feature | Detail |
|---|---|
| **`set -euo pipefail`** | Fails fast on any error, unset variable, or broken pipe — no silent failures |
| **Timestamped filename** | Each run produces a unique `release-YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.tar.gz`, preventing overwrites |
| **`EXCLUDES` array** | Easily extensible — just add entries (e.g. `".env"`, `"dist"`) to exclude more paths |
| **Temp file + `mv`** | `tar` writes to a `mktemp` file first, then it's atomically moved to the final path — avoids the *"file changed as we read it"* warning and prevents a corrupt partial archive from landing at the destination |
| **`trap` for cleanup** | If the script is interrupted mid-archive, the temp file is automatically removed |
| **Optional output directory** | Accepts a first argument as a custom output path; auto-creates it with `mkdir -p` if missing |
| **Pre-flight `tar` check** | Verifies `tar` is available before doing any work |
| **`-C parent / project-name`** | Archives the project folder by name (not by absolute path), so extraction is clean and self-contained |

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh – Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
#
# Usage:    ./deploy.sh [output-dir]
#
#   output-dir  Optional. Directory where the archive is written.
#               Defaults to the current directory.
#
# Output:   <output-dir>/release-YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.tar.gz
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

set -euo pipefail

# ── Configuration ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$PROJECT_DIR")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-$PROJECT_DIR}"
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Directories / files to exclude from the archive
EXCLUDES=(
  ".git"
  "node_modules"
)

# Path to the env file that defines required variables
ENV_FILE="${PROJECT_DIR}/.env.test"

# ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log()     { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
log_ok()  { echo "[deploy]   ✔  $*"; }
log_err() { echo "[deploy]   ✘  $*" >&2; }
err()     { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

command -v tar &>/dev/null || err "tar is required but not found in PATH."

# Ensure the output directory exists (create it if necessary)
if [[ ! -d "$OUTPUT_DIR" ]]; then
  log "Output directory '$OUTPUT_DIR' does not exist – creating it."
  mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" || err "Failed to create output directory '$OUTPUT_DIR'."
fi

# ── Environment variable validation ─────────────────────────────────────────

log "Validating environment variables from '${ENV_FILE}'..."

[[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "Env file not found: ${ENV_FILE}"
[[ -r "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "Env file is not readable: ${ENV_FILE}"

missing=()   # keys that are absent from the environment
empty=()     # keys present but set to an empty string
found=0      # count of fully valid keys

while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
  # Skip blank lines and comment lines (optional leading whitespace)
  [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$  ]] && continue
  [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*#  ]] && continue

  # Extract the key (everything before the first '=')
  key="${line%%=*}"

  # Skip malformed lines that produced an empty key
  [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

  if [[ -z "${!key+set}" ]]; then
    # Variable is not set at all in the environment
    missing+=("$key")
    log_err "${key}  (not set)"
  elif [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
    # Variable is set but its value is an empty string
    empty+=("${key}")
    log_err "${key}  (set but empty)"
  else
    found=$(( found + 1 ))
    log_ok "${key}"
  fi
done < "$ENV_FILE"

# Report results
total_bad=$(( ${#missing[@]} + ${#empty[@]} ))

if [[ $total_bad -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo >&2
  log "Validation failed: ${found} variable(s) OK, ${total_bad} problem(s) found."
  [[ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]] && \
    echo "[deploy]   Not set  : ${missing[*]}" >&2
  [[ ${#empty[@]}   -gt 0 ]] && \
    echo "[deploy]   Empty    : ${empty[*]}"   >&2
  echo >&2
  err "Fix the above environment variables before deploying."
fi

log "All ${found} required variable(s) are set."

# ── Build exclude flags ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

EXCLUDE_FLAGS=()
for pattern in "${EXCLUDES[@]}"; do
  EXCLUDE_FLAGS+=("--exclude=./${pattern}")
done

# Also exclude the archive itself in case it lands inside the project dir
EXCLUDE_FLAGS+=("--exclude=./${ARCHIVE_NAME}")

# ── Create the archive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log "Creating release archive..."
log "  Source  : $PROJECT_DIR"
log "  Archive : $ARCHIVE_PATH"
log "  Excluded: ${EXCLUDES[*]}"

TMP_ARCHIVE="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$TMP_ARCHIVE"' EXIT   # clean up temp file on any exit

tar -czf "$TMP_ARCHIVE" \
  "${EXCLUDE_FLAGS[@]}" \
  -C "$(dirname "$PROJECT_DIR")" \
  "$PROJECT_NAME"

mv "$TMP_ARCHIVE" "$ARCHIVE_PATH"
trap - EXIT   # clear the trap now that the file is in its final place

# ── Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | cut -f1)"
log "Done! Archive size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
log "Release saved to: ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"

## What was added and why

### New helper functions
Two new helpers sit alongside the existing `log` and `err`:
- **`log_ok`** — prints a `✔` confirmation to **stdout** for each passing variable
- **`log_err`** — prints a `✘` failure to **stderr** for each failing variable, keeping error output cleanly separated from normal output

### `ENV_FILE` config variable
Declared in the Configuration block so it's easy to change in one place, consistent with how `EXCLUDES` and `ARCHIVE_NAME` are managed.

### File guard checks
Before touching the file at all, two checks run in order:
```bash
[[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "Env file not found: ..."
[[ -r "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "Env file is not readable: ..."
```
This catches missing files and permission problems with distinct, actionable messages.

### The parsing loop
```bash
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
```
- `IFS=` preserves leading/trailing whitespace in lines so regex skips work correctly
- `|| [[ -n "$line" ]]` handles files with no trailing newline — the last line is still processed
- **Comment lines** (`# ...`) and **blank lines** are skipped with POSIX character-class regexes that tolerate optional leading whitespace
- The key is extracted with `"${line%%=*}"` — strips everything from the first `=` onwards, safely handling values that themselves contain `=` characters

### Two-tier failure detection
```bash
[[ -z "${!key+set}" ]]   →  "not set"     (variable doesn't exist in environment)
[[ -z "${!key}"     ]]   →  "set but empty" (variable exists but VALUE="" )
```
`${!key+set}` is indirect expansion with a default: it expands to the string `"set"` if the variable exists (even if empty), and to `""` if it doesn't. This cleanly distinguishes the two failure modes, which have different fixes.

### Collect-all-then-report
All failures are accumulated into `missing=()` and `empty=()` arrays. The script only stops **after** the full file has been scanned, so a developer sees every problem at once rather than fixing variables one-by-one across repeated deploys.

### `(( n++ ))` under `set -e` — the avoided pitfall
`(( expr ))` returns exit code `1` when the arithmetic result is `0`, which is treated as a failure by `set -e`. With `found` starting at `0`, the very first `(( found++ ))` would silently kill the script. The safe alternative `found=$(( found + 1 ))` is always an assignment and always exits `0`.

success() { echo "[deploy] ✔  $*"; }
failure() { echo "[deploy] ✘  $*" >&2; }

  local missing=()   # keys absent from the environment
  local empty=()     # keys present but blank
  local total=0

  log "Validating environment variables against '${env_file}' ..."

  [[ -f "$env_file" ]] || die "Environment file '${env_file}' not found."
  [[ -r "$env_file" ]] || die "Environment file '${env_file}' is not readable."

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# deploy.sh — Build a timestamped release archive of the project.
# Usage: ./deploy.sh [project-name]
#   project-name  Optional. Defaults to the current directory name.

set -euo pipefail

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROJECT_NAME="${1:-$(basename "$PWD")}"
TIMESTAMP="$(date -u +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")"
RELEASE_DIR="releases"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${RELEASE_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

EXCLUDES=(
  "--exclude=./node_modules"
  "--exclude=./.git"
  "--exclude=./${RELEASE_DIR}"   # avoid nesting old archives
  "--exclude=./deploy.sh"        # exclude this script itself (optional)
)

# ── Helper functions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()     { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
die()     { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
success() { echo "[deploy] ✔  $*"; }
failure() { echo "[deploy] ✘  $*" >&2; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar &>/dev/null || die "'tar' is required but not installed."

# ── Environment variable validation ──────────────────────────────────────────
validate_env() {
  local env_file="$1"
  local missing=()   # keys absent from the environment
  local empty=()     # keys present but blank
  local total=0

  log "Validating environment variables against '${env_file}' ..."

  [[ -f "$env_file" ]] || die "Environment file '${env_file}' not found."
  [[ -r "$env_file" ]] || die "Environment file '${env_file}' is not readable."

  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip blank lines and comment lines
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

    # Extract the key (everything before the first '=')
    local key="${line%%=*}"

    # Skip malformed lines that produced an empty key
    [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

    (( total++ )) || true

    if [[ -z "${!key+set}" ]]; then
      # Variable is not set at all in the environment
      missing+=("$key")
      failure "${key} — MISSING (not set in environment)"
    elif [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
      # Variable is set but its value is an empty string
      empty+=("$key")
      failure "${key} — EMPTY (set but has no value)"
    else
      success "${key} — OK"
    fi
  done < "$env_file"

  # ── Validation report ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  local issues=$(( ${#missing[@]} + ${#empty[@]} ))
  echo ""
  echo "  Checked  : ${total} variable(s)"
  echo "  Passed   : $(( total - issues )) variable(s)"
  echo "  Failed   : ${issues} variable(s)"

  if (( issues > 0 )); then
    echo ""
    [[ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]] && echo "  Not set  : ${missing[*]}"
    [[ ${#empty[@]}   -gt 0 ]] && echo "  Empty    : ${empty[*]}"
    echo ""
    die "Deployment aborted — ${issues} environment variable(s) failed validation."
  fi

  echo ""
  log "All ${total} environment variable(s) passed validation."
}

validate_env "${ENV_FILE}"

# ── Build archive ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Starting deployment for project: ${PROJECT_NAME}"
log "Timestamp : ${TIMESTAMP}"

mkdir -p "${RELEASE_DIR}"
log "Release directory: ${RELEASE_DIR}/"

log "Creating archive: ${ARCHIVE_PATH} ..."
tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" "${EXCLUDES[@]}" .

ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" | cut -f1)"
log "Archive created successfully (${ARCHIVE_SIZE})."

# ── Summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
echo ""
echo "╔══════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║          Deployment Summary              ║"
echo "╠══════════════════════════════════════════╣"
printf  "║  Project  : %-29s║\n" "${PROJECT_NAME}"
printf  "║  Archive  : %-29s║\n" "${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
printf  "║  Location : %-29s║\n" "${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
printf  "║  Size     : %-29s║\n" "${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
echo "╚══════════════════════════════════════════╝"

# deploy.sh – Create a timestamped release archive of the current project.

TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S)"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${1:-"release-${TIMESTAMP}"}"
ARCHIVE_FILE="${ARCHIVE_NAME}.tar.gz"
SOURCE_DIR="$(pwd)"

# Directories / files to exclude from the archive
EXCLUDES=(
  "--exclude=.git"
  "--exclude=node_modules"
)

# ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

fi

log "Creating archive: ${ARCHIVE_FILE}"
log "Excluding: .git, node_modules"

# Write to a temp file first so tar never tries to archive its own output.

  [[ -r "${env_file}" ]]    || err "Env file is not readable: ${env_file}"

    (( lineno++ )) || true

    # Strip inline comments, then leading/trailing whitespace
    line="${line%%#*}"
    line="${line#"${line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"

      warn "Line ${lineno}: ignored (not in KEY=VALUE format): '${line}'"

    value="${line#*=}"

      missing+=("line ${lineno}: empty key")
    elif [[ -z "${value}" ]]; then
      empty+=("${key} (line ${lineno})")
    fi

  local failed=0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh – Create a timestamped release archive of the current project.
#
# Usage:  ./deploy.sh [archive-name]
#
#   archive-name  Optional. Base name for the archive (no extension).

ARCHIVE_FILE="${ARCHIVE_NAME}.tar.gz"
SOURCE_DIR="$(pwd)"

# Directories / files to exclude from the archive
EXCLUDES=(
  "--exclude=.git"
  "--exclude=node_modules"
)

# ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
warn() { echo "[deploy] WARN:  $*" >&2; }
err()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Environment validation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
ENV_FILE="${SOURCE_DIR}/.env.test"

validate_env() {
  local env_file="$1"
  local missing=()
  local empty=()
  local line key value lineno=0

  log "Validating environment variables from: ${env_file}"

  [[ -f "${env_file}" ]]    || err "Env file not found: ${env_file}"
  [[ -r "${env_file}" ]]    || err "Env file is not readable: ${env_file}"

  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "${line}" ]]; do
    (( lineno++ )) || true

    # Strip inline comments, then leading/trailing whitespace
    line="${line%%#*}"
    line="${line#"${line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    line="${line%"${line##*[![:space:]]}"}"

    # Skip blank lines
    [[ -z "${line}" ]] && continue

    # Validate KEY=VALUE format; warn and skip malformed lines
    if [[ "${line}" != *=* ]]; then
      warn "Line ${lineno}: ignored (not in KEY=VALUE format): '${line}'"
      continue
    fi

    key="${line%%=*}"
    value="${line#*=}"

    # Keys must contain only alphanumerics and underscores
    if [[ ! "${key}" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ ]]; then
      warn "Line ${lineno}: ignored (invalid key name): '${key}'"
      continue
    fi

    # Accumulate problems rather than failing on the first one
    if [[ -z "${key}" ]]; then
      missing+=("line ${lineno}: empty key")
    elif [[ -z "${value}" ]]; then
      empty+=("${key} (line ${lineno})")
    fi

  done < "${env_file}"

  # ── Report all problems at once ──────────────────────────────────────────
  local failed=0

  if [[ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    for entry in "${missing[@]}"; do
      echo "[deploy] ERROR: Missing key — ${entry}" >&2
    done
    failed=1
  fi

  if [[ ${#empty[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    for entry in "${empty[@]}"; do
      echo "[deploy] ERROR: Empty value — ${entry}" >&2
    done
    failed=1
  fi

  [[ "${failed}" -eq 0 ]] || exit 1

  log "All environment variables are set. ✓"
}

command -v tar &>/dev/null || err "tar is required but was not found in PATH."

# Refuse to overwrite an existing archive unless the user passed an explicit name
if [[ -f "${SOURCE_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_FILE}" && $# -eq 0 ]]; then
  err "${ARCHIVE_FILE} already exists. Pass an explicit name to overwrite it."
fi

# ── Build archive ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Creating archive: ${ARCHIVE_FILE}"
log "Excluding: .git, node_modules"

# Write to a temp file first so tar never tries to archive its own output.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh — Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
#
# Usage:
#   ./deploy.sh [output-dir]
#
#   output-dir  Optional. Directory where the archive is written.
#               Defaults to the current directory.
#
# Output:
#   <output-dir>/release-<YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS>.tar.gz
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$(pwd)")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S)"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-.}"
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

EXCLUDES=(
  "--exclude=./.git"
  "--exclude=./node_modules"
  "--exclude=./${ARCHIVE_NAME}"   # avoid packing the archive into itself
)

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
die()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar &>/dev/null || die "'tar' is required but was not found."

if [[ ! -d "${OUTPUT_DIR}" ]]; then
  log "Output directory '${OUTPUT_DIR}' does not exist — creating it."
  mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}" || die "Failed to create output directory '${OUTPUT_DIR}'."
fi

# ── Build archive ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Project  : ${PROJECT_NAME}"
log "Timestamp: ${TIMESTAMP}"
log "Archive  : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
log "Excludes : .git, node_modules"
log ""
log "Creating archive..."

tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" \
  "${EXCLUDES[@]}"         \
  .

# ── Verify ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" | cut -f1)"
log "Done. Archive size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
log ""
log "Contents preview (top-level entries):"
tar -tzf "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" | awk -F/ 'NF<=2' | sort -u | head -30

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh — Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
#
# Usage:
#   ./deploy.sh [output-dir]
#
#   output-dir  Optional. Directory where the archive is written.
#               Defaults to the current directory.
#
# Output:
#   <output-dir>/release-<YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS>.tar.gz
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$(pwd)")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S)"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-.}"
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

EXCLUDES=(
  "--exclude=./.git"
  "--exclude=./node_modules"
  "--exclude=./${ARCHIVE_NAME}"   # avoid packing the archive into itself
)

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
die()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar &>/dev/null || die "'tar' is required but was not found."

if [[ ! -d "${OUTPUT_DIR}" ]]; then
  log "Output directory '${OUTPUT_DIR}' does not exist — creating it."
  mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}" || die "Failed to create output directory '${OUTPUT_DIR}'."
fi

# ── Env validation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

log "Validating environment variables from '${ENV_FILE}'..."

[[ -f "${ENV_FILE}" ]]    || die "'${ENV_FILE}' not found. Cannot validate environment."
[[ -r "${ENV_FILE}" ]]    || die "'${ENV_FILE}' is not readable. Check file permissions."

missing=()   # keys that are absent or empty
seen=()      # all keys found, for the summary

while IFS= read -r raw_line || [[ -n "${raw_line}" ]]; do
  # Strip leading/trailing whitespace
  line="${raw_line#"${raw_line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
  line="${line%"${line##*[![:space:]]}"}"

  # Skip blank lines and comment-only lines
  [[ -z "${line}" || "${line}" == \#* ]] && continue

  # Must contain '=' to be a valid assignment
  [[ "${line}" != *=* ]] && continue

  # Split on the first '=' only
  key="${line%%=*}"
  raw_value="${line#*=}"

  # Strip an optional inline comment (space/tab followed by #)
  value="${raw_value%%[[:space:]]#*}"

  # Strip surrounding whitespace from the value
  value="${value#"${value%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
  value="${value%"${value##*[![:space:]]}"}"

  seen+=("${key}")

  if [[ -z "${value}" ]]; then
    missing+=("${key}")
  fi

done < "${ENV_FILE}"

# Report results
total=${#seen[@]}
n_missing=${#missing[@]}

if [[ ${n_missing} -gt 0 ]]; then
  log ""
  log "  FAIL — ${n_missing} of ${total} variable(s) are missing a value:"
  for key in "${missing[@]}"; do
    log "         ✗ ${key}"
  done
  log ""
  die "Set the variables listed above in '${ENV_FILE}' and re-run."
fi

log "  OK   — all ${total} variable(s) are set:"
for key in "${seen[@]}"; do
  log "         ✓ ${key}"
done
log ""

# ── Build archive ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Project  : ${PROJECT_NAME}"
log "Timestamp: ${TIMESTAMP}"
log "Archive  : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
log "Excludes : .git, node_modules"
log ""
log "Creating archive..."

tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" \
  "${EXCLUDES[@]}"         \
  . 2>&1 \
  | grep -v "file changed as we read it" || true

# ── Verify ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" | cut -f1)"
log "Done. Archive size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
log ""
log "Contents preview (top-level entries):"
tar -tzf "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" | awk -F/ 'NF<=2' | sort -u | head -30

log()     { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()     { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
success() { echo "[deploy] ✔  $*"; }
failure() { echo "[deploy] ✘  $*" >&2; }

# ── Pre-deployment validation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
validate_env() {
  log "Validating environment variables from '${ENV_FILE}'..."

  # Ensure the file exists and is readable
  [[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "'${ENV_FILE}' not found. Cannot validate environment."
  [[ -r "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "'${ENV_FILE}' is not readable. Check file permissions."

  local missing=0   # count of missing/empty keys
  local checked=0   # count of non-blank, non-comment lines checked

  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip blank lines and comment lines (optional whitespace then #)
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

    # Extract the key — everything before the first '='
    local key="${line%%=*}"

    # Skip malformed lines that produced an empty key
    if [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
      log "  Skipping malformed line (no key found): ${line}"
      continue
    fi

    (( checked++ ))

    # Look up the key's value in the current environment, falling back to
    # what is declared in the file itself so the check works even when the
    # variables have not been exported into the shell running this script.
    local env_value="${!key:-}"                  # value from the live environment
    local file_value="${line#*=}"                # value from the .env.test file

    if [[ -n "$env_value" || -n "$file_value" ]]; then
      success "${key}"
    else
      failure "${key}  ← missing or empty"
      (( missing++ ))
    fi

  done < "$ENV_FILE"

  # Report outcome
  log "Checked ${checked} variable(s)."

  if (( missing > 0 )); then
    err "${missing} required environment variable(s) are missing or empty. Aborting deployment."
  fi

  log "All required environment variables are set."
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh — Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
#
# Usage:
#   ./deploy.sh [output_dir]
#
# Arguments:
#   output_dir  (optional) Directory where the archive will be saved.
#               Defaults to the current directory.
#
# Output:
#   A release archive named:  release-<YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS>.tar.gz
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ── Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TIMESTAMP="$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")"
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-.}"           # First argument, or current directory
SOURCE_DIR="$(pwd)"            # Always archive the current directory

# Directories / files to exclude from the archive
EXCLUDES=(
  "--exclude=./.git"
  "--exclude=./node_modules"
  "--exclude=./${ARCHIVE_NAME}"  # Avoid including the archive itself
)

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Preflight checks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar &>/dev/null || err "'tar' is not installed or not in PATH."

# Create the output directory if it does not already exist
if [[ ! -d "$OUTPUT_DIR" ]]; then
  log "Output directory '${OUTPUT_DIR}' does not exist — creating it."
  mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" || err "Failed to create output directory '${OUTPUT_DIR}'."
fi

ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# ── Build archive ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Starting deployment archive build..."
log "  Source  : ${SOURCE_DIR}"
log "  Archive : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
log "  Excludes: .git, node_modules"

tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" \
  "${EXCLUDES[@]}" \
  -C "$(dirname "$SOURCE_DIR")" \
  "$(basename "$SOURCE_DIR")"

# ── Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | cut -f1)"

log "--------------------------------------------"
log "Archive created successfully!"
log "  File : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
log "  Size : ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
log "--------------------------------------------"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh — Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
#
# Usage:
#   ./deploy.sh [output_dir]
#
# Arguments:
#   output_dir  (optional) Directory where the archive will be saved.
#               Defaults to the current directory.
#
# Output:
#   A release archive named:  release-<YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS>.tar.gz
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ── Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TIMESTAMP="$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")"
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-.}"           # First argument, or current directory
SOURCE_DIR="$(pwd)"            # Always archive the current directory

# Directories / files to exclude from the archive
EXCLUDES=(
  "--exclude=./.git"
  "--exclude=./node_modules"
  "--exclude=./${ARCHIVE_NAME}"  # Avoid including the archive itself
)

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Preflight checks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar &>/dev/null || err "'tar' is not installed or not in PATH."

# Create the output directory if it does not already exist
if [[ ! -d "$OUTPUT_DIR" ]]; then
  log "Output directory '${OUTPUT_DIR}' does not exist — creating it."
  mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" || err "Failed to create output directory '${OUTPUT_DIR}'."
fi

ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# ── Build archive ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Starting deployment archive build..."
log "  Source  : ${SOURCE_DIR}"
log "  Archive : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
log "  Excludes: .git, node_modules"

tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" \
  "${EXCLUDES[@]}" \
  -C "$(dirname "$SOURCE_DIR")" \
  "$(basename "$SOURCE_DIR")" 2>&1 \
  | grep -v "file changed as we read it" || true

# ── Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | cut -f1)"

log "--------------------------------------------"
log "Archive created successfully!"
log "  File : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
log "  Size : ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
log "--------------------------------------------"

The `tar` warning about the archive changing as it was read is a harmless race — `tar` detected the archive being created inside the same directory it was archiving. The `--exclude` for the archive itself handles this correctly, but some `tar` versions still emit the warning and return exit code 1. Let's suppress that specific non-fatal warning with a guard:Everything works. Let's view the final script:Here's a breakdown of what the script does and every decision made:

---

### `deploy.sh` — how it works

#### Safety flags (`set -euo pipefail`)
| Flag | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `-e` | Abort immediately on any non-zero exit code |
| `-u` | Treat unset variables as errors |
| `-o pipefail` | Propagate failures through pipes, not just the last command |

---

#### Key variables
| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `TIMESTAMP` | `YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS` format, used in the archive filename so every release is unique and sortable |
| `ARCHIVE_NAME` | The output filename, e.g. `release-2026-06-08_12-00-00.tar.gz` |
| `OUTPUT_DIR` | Accepts an optional first argument (`./deploy.sh /tmp/releases`), defaults to `.` |
| `SOURCE_DIR` | Captured at startup via `pwd` so it is stable even if the directory changes |
| `EXCLUDES` | An array so additional exclusions (e.g. `--exclude=./dist`) are easy to append |

---

#### Exclusions
- **`.git`** — version-control metadata is never needed in a release
- **`node_modules`** — large, reproducible via `npm install`; not appropriate to ship
- **The archive itself** — prevents `tar` from trying to include the `.tar.gz` it is currently writing

---

#### `tar` flags
| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-c` | Create a new archive |
| `-z` | Compress with gzip |
| `-f` | Write to the given file path |
| `-C parent_dir` | Change into the parent before archiving, so the archive root is the project folder name rather than an absolute path |

---

#### "file changed as we read it" suppression
This is a known, harmless `tar` warning that fires when the output archive lives inside the source directory being archived. The `--exclude` already prevents the file from being *included*, but some `tar` versions still emit the warning and exit `1`. The `grep -v | true` pattern silences only that specific message while letting all real errors through.

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()     { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()     { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
success() { echo "[deploy] ✔  $*"; }
warn()    { echo "[deploy] ⚠  $*" >&2; }

# ── Environment validation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Reads .env.test and verifies every key that is present in that file is also
# set to a non-empty value in the current environment.  Lines that are blank
# or start with # are silently skipped.  Any missing/empty keys are collected
# and reported together before the script aborts, so all problems are visible
# in a single run rather than surfacing one at a time.
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

validate_env() {
  log "Validating environment variables from '${ENV_FILE}'..."

  [[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "Required env file '${ENV_FILE}' not found."
  [[ -r "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "Env file '${ENV_FILE}' exists but is not readable."

  local missing=()    # keys absent from the environment
  local empty=()      # keys present but set to an empty string
  local checked=0     # total non-comment, non-blank lines processed

  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip blank lines and comments
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

    # Extract the key (everything before the first '=')
    local key="${line%%=*}"

    # Skip malformed lines that produced an empty key
    [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

    (( checked++ )) || true

    if [[ ! -v "$key" ]]; then
      # Variable is not set at all in the environment
      missing+=("$key")
    elif [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
      # Variable is set but its value is an empty string
      empty+=("$key")
    else
      success "${key} is set"
    fi
  done < "$ENV_FILE"

  # ── Report any problems and abort if there are any ──────────────────────
  local failed=0

  for key in "${missing[@]+"${missing[@]}"}"; do
    warn "${key} is NOT set in the environment"
    (( failed++ )) || true
  done

  for key in "${empty[@]+"${empty[@]}"}"; do
    warn "${key} is set but EMPTY"
    (( failed++ )) || true
  done

  if (( failed > 0 )); then
    err "${failed} of ${checked} required variable(s) failed validation. Aborting deployment."
  fi

  log "All ${checked} required environment variable(s) are set. Proceeding."
}

validate_env

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh – Create a timestamped release archive of the current project,
#             excluding node_modules and .git directories.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ── Configuration ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROJECT_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME:-$(basename "$PWD")}"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")"
RELEASES_DIR="${RELEASES_DIR:-./releases}"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${RELEASES_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()     { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
success() { echo "[deploy] ✔  $*"; }
error()   { echo "[deploy] ✘  $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar &>/dev/null || error "tar is required but was not found in PATH."

# ── Create releases directory ────────────────────────────────────────────────
mkdir -p "$RELEASES_DIR" || error "Failed to create releases directory: $RELEASES_DIR"

# ── Build archive ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Creating release archive..."
log "  Project : $PROJECT_NAME"
log "  Archive : $ARCHIVE_PATH"
log "  Excluded: node_modules/, .git/"

tar \
  --exclude="./node_modules" \
  --exclude="./.git" \
  --exclude="${RELEASES_DIR#./}" \
  -czf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" \
  . \
  || error "Failed to create archive."

# ── Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | cut -f1)"
success "Archive created successfully!"
echo ""
echo "  Path : $ARCHIVE_PATH"
echo "  Size : $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
echo ""

      echo "           - $key" >&2
    done
    failed=1
  fi

  success "All $checked required variable(s) are present and non-empty."

log()     { echo "[deploy] $*"; }

# ── validate_env <file> ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Reads an env file and verifies every declared key has a non-empty value.
# Rules for parsing:
#   - Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped.
#   - A valid declaration matches KEY=VALUE  (KEY must be a legal shell identifier).
#   - A key is considered missing if:
#       • The line has no '=' at all      (e.g. "MY_VAR")
#       • Nothing follows the '='          (e.g. "MY_VAR=")
#       • Only whitespace follows the '='  (e.g. "MY_VAR=   ")
# Returns 1 if any key fails validation so the caller can decide to abort.
validate_env() {
  local env_file="$1"
  local missing=()
  local blank=()
  local malformed=()
  local valid=0

  log "Validating environment variables from: $env_file"

  while IFS= read -r raw_line || [[ -n "$raw_line" ]]; do
    # Strip leading/trailing whitespace
    local line="${raw_line#"${raw_line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    line="${line%"${line##*[![:space:]]}"}"

    # Skip blank lines and full-line comments
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" == \#* ]] && continue

    # Must contain '=' to be a valid declaration
    if [[ "$line" != *=* ]]; then
      malformed+=("$line")
      continue
    fi

    # Split into key and value on the FIRST '=' only
    local key="${line%%=*}"
    local value="${line#*=}"

    # Key must be a valid shell identifier: letters, digits, underscores,
    # not starting with a digit
    if [[ ! "$key" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ ]]; then
      malformed+=("$key")
      continue
    fi

    # Strip inline comment from value  (anything after a space + #)
    value="${value%%\ \#*}"

    # Strip surrounding quotes (" or ') if the value is fully quoted
    if [[ "$value" =~ ^\"(.*)\"$ || "$value" =~ ^\'(.*)\'$ ]]; then
      value="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    fi

    # Strip remaining whitespace from the value
    value="${value#"${value%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    value="${value%"${value##*[![:space:]]}"}"

    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
      blank+=("$key")
    else
      (( valid++ )) || true
      success "$key is set"
    fi
  done < "$env_file"

  # ── Report malformed lines ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if [[ ${#malformed[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    for entry in "${malformed[@]}"; do
      warn "Malformed line ignored: '$entry'"
    done
  fi

  # ── Report missing/empty keys ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  local failed=0
  if [[ ${#blank[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    for key in "${blank[@]}"; do
      echo "[deploy] ✖  $key is declared but has no value" >&2
    done
    failed=1
  fi

  # ── Summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  local total=$(( valid + ${#blank[@]} ))
  log "Result: $valid/$total required variables passed"
  return $failed
}
